name: M5.ConditionalCount.selected_divisor_indicator
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B U V : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → M5.ConditionalCount.selectedDivisorSum N A B U V = (if M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N (A ∪ U) (B ∪ V) = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
guidance: The selected supportGcd divides positive N and is positive. Apply Connectivity.connected_indicator at that gcd to U,V. Identify resulting gcd with supportGcd N(A union U)(B union V), using Finset.gcd_union and Nat gcd associativity/commutativity, or divisibility antisymmetry with support_gcd_dvd. Return tactic lines only without leading by; keep exact target.
